name: Lattice-Based Cryptography Assessment
description: Assessment of lattice-based post-quantum cryptographic schemes including ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber), ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium), and FN-DSA (Falcon; draft FIPS 206, not yet final). Covers parameter selection review, implementation correctness, side-channel resistance, and compliance with NIST FIPS 203/204 standards.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to lattice-based cryptography assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the quantum threat to classical cryptography and why lattice-based schemes are needed
evidence: Can explain why RSA and ECC are vulnerable to quantum computers (Shor's algorithm)
Understands the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem at a conceptual level
Can name NIST-standardised lattice-based schemes (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) and their purposes

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies lattice-based scheme deployments and reviews parameter selections under supervision
evidence: Identifies ML-KEM and ML-DSA usage in TLS 1.3 hybrid key exchange and signing contexts
Reviews parameter level selection (ML-KEM-512/768/1024) against security requirements under guidance
Uses reference implementations and test vectors to validate correct operation
Documents post-quantum findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses lattice-based cryptography deployments for correctness and security
evidence: Evaluates ML-KEM/ML-DSA implementations against FIPS 203/204 requirements
Assesses parameter selection relative to target security levels and deployment requirements (e.g., CNSA 2.0 requires ML-KEM-1024 and ML-DSA-87, so ML-KEM-512/768 do not meet it)
Identifies implementation deviations from specification that may introduce weaknesses
Produces findings with references to NIST FIPS 203, FIPS 204, and migration guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex lattice-based deployment assessments; evaluates side-channel resistance
evidence: Evaluates lattice-based implementations for timing and power analysis side-channels
Assesses hybrid classical/post-quantum key exchange configurations (e.g., X25519+ML-KEM)
Reviews decapsulation failure handling for correctness and side-channel safety
Mentors junior staff on lattice-based cryptography assessment

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lattice-based assessment methodology; recognised authority on post-quantum lattice schemes
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's lattice-based cryptography assessment methodology
Published research on lattice-based scheme implementations or vulnerabilities
Provides expert guidance on ML-KEM/ML-DSA deployment strategies and parameter selection
Trains teams on lattice-based cryptography internals and assessment approaches

assessment_methods.description: Assess a TLS 1.3 deployment using hybrid ML-KEM key exchange: evaluate parameter selection, implementation correctness, and fallback behaviour
Given an ML-KEM implementation, verify compliance with FIPS 203 and identify any deviations that could weaken security
